Opus-MT translation models

Lector downloads Opus-MT models on demand for offline translation. They are not
bundled with the app.

Models: Opus-MT, by the Language Technology Research Group at the University of Helsinki
(Helsinki-NLP). https://github.com/Helsinki-NLP/Opus-MT

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Changes: the original models were converted to the ONNX format by their publishers on
Hugging Face (Xenova, onnx-community, R4kSo1997, TigreGotico, fintutto). Lector uses
those conversions unmodified, at the exact revisions pinned in OpusMTCatalog+Models.swift.

Reference:
Jörg Tiedemann and Santhosh Thottingal. 2020. OPUS-MT — Building open translation
services for the World. In Proceedings of the 22nd Annual Conference of the European
Association for Machine Translation (EAMT), Lisbon, Portugal.
